text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wooow! You guys tracked me down<n>just to wish
me happy birthday?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're the best! With all the birthday<n>wishes I've
gotten, maybe I'll grow<n>even bigger.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Must be nice. I wish I wasn't taking<n>so long to be
all grown-up like you<n>are!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Same here! If I could be like you, that<n>would be
super marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, did you know there's a<n>super food
that'll make you grow<n>just like that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's yummy, makes you happy, and<n>leaves your
mind and body feeling<n>warm all over! And this
incredible dish<n>is called...
